observation: The exact 115 retained HCC samples cannot be reconstructed from the 183-row supplement.
evidence: The supplement describes all raw samples while the paper reports 115 after pathology and QC without a retained-ID/exclusion table.
consequence: Exact integrated analyses and sample-level claims cannot be independently reproduced.
proposed_action: Request the manifest or rebuild with an explicit immutable inclusion/exclusion table and treat it as an independent reconstruction.
current_resolution: Recorded in anchor audit and defect HCC-DR02.
notes: Blocks exact reproduction, not use of the framework.

observation: The stated older HCC spatial-data link was not reachable during audit.
evidence: Article data statement points to the Lifeome URL; connection attempt failed.
consequence: The complete original spatial layer cannot currently be reconstructed from the stated public source.
proposed_action: Locate an archived/controlled repository or use a clearly substituted public spatial cohort with revised claims.
current_resolution: Recorded as unavailable dependency in figure map.
notes: Recheck before finalizing any reproduction statement.

observation: Custom author analysis code is request-only.
evidence: Article says custom code and all other data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
consequence: Exact preprocessing, cNMF, spatial and Geneformer results cannot be matched to the authors' implementation.
proposed_action: Request code while independently rebuilding from pinned official/qualified donors with module contracts and smoke tests.
current_resolution: Official donors inspected; none smoke-tested for this Pilot.
notes: Blocks exact reproduction and route readiness, not candidate generation.

observation: Paper2Paper records minimum subjects only for an entire candidate, not per decisive comparison group.
evidence: The anchor appears large overall but the supplied manifest has PVTT n=2 and MLN n=1; current data_requirements.tsv cannot encode separate group minima.
consequence: A structurally valid route can still be scientifically non-inferential.
proposed_action: Require per-comparison independent-unit counts, pairing and repetition before accepting the data for a stated paper task; do not use total subjects as a substitute.
current_resolution: The rule is now part of the core data-discovery guidance and was applied in this Pilot; the scientific limitation remains open for any selected target route.
notes: This is a real false-feasibility risk; the product repair blocks unchecked use but is not an automated proof of sample adequacy.

observation: Paper2Paper has no cohort-by-state confounding representation or guard.
evidence: Target candidates assemble progression states from different studies/platforms; the anchor itself mixes rare advanced states across datasets.
consequence: A disease-progression signal may be a dataset effect.
proposed_action: Require a patient × state × cohort × platform design table and bridge/holdout evidence before progression language.
current_resolution: The check is now part of the core data-discovery guidance; no target-cancer route has been selected or executed.
notes: Blocks promotion, not data search; no automated guard is claimed.

observation: The current Pilot now exercises a 31 GB multi-cohort single-cell foundation chain, but not the later spatial, clinical or GPU perturbation modules.
evidence: P0.0-P0.6 have real diagnostic evidence while the target-paper Figure chain beyond the foundation layer has not run.
consequence: Paper2Paper still cannot honestly claim end-to-end multi-modal cancer-switch capability.
proposed_action: Keep the capability boundary explicit and continue from the real foundation result to the smallest decisive Figure chain after P0-GATE review.
current_resolution: CRC Phase 0 real execution is active and documented; no manuscript route or full multi-modal run is claimed.
notes: This is missing evidence for the current paper type, not a reason to build an abstract capability platform.

observation: CRC-atlas is public but its main objects and archives range from about 31 GB to 299 GiB.
evidence: CELLxGENE H5AD is 30,875,155,333 bytes; Zenodo publishes large modular archives; BioImage Xenium index totals 321,349,219,536 bytes.
consequence: A beginner can exhaust storage or download irrelevant raw morphology before producing a decision.
proposed_action: Require a run-capacity receipt and select only the smallest files needed for the approved decision experiment.
current_resolution: The 30,875,155,333-byte H5AD was downloaded once to the cloud server, SHA256-verified, and reused through a receipt chain; unrelated 299-GiB-class spatial archives were not downloaded.
notes: This Pilot verifies capacity-aware role selection and checksum reuse on a real large object.

observation: The CRC-atlas Xenium assay cannot measure many candidate malignant or myeloid program genes.
evidence: The parsed 380-gene panel omits SPP1, APOC1, HSP90B1, KRT8/18/19 and has 0/20 to 11/20 coverage across published myeloid programs.
consequence: A visually convincing spatial map could be generated from an undermeasured signature and falsely treated as validation.
proposed_action: Require a measurement-space coverage receipt before assigning any restricted assay to a program-projection Figure.
current_resolution: The rule is now part of the core data-discovery guidance and the CRC panel audit already prevents a full-program validation claim.
notes: The dataset can still serve suitable localization roles; it is not rejected wholesale.

observation: The CRC-atlas repository is extensive but its documented downstream workflow is incomplete and several paths are author-server-specific.
evidence: At commit 82c15ecc, workflows/downstream_analyses.nf and conf/downstream_analyses.config are absent; configuration and launch files contain /data/projects or /data/scratch paths.
consequence: Repository existence could be mistaken for a reliable end-to-end target-paper pipeline.
proposed_action: Pin the commit, parameterize paths, construct a downstream runner and run module-level smoke tests before selecting any code candidate for use.
current_resolution: Portable P0.0-P0.6 adapters have now run on the published H5AD; the absent author downstream workflow and later spatial/clinical/perturbation modules remain unresolved rather than being treated as supplied.
notes: Foundation code was repaired and reused; this does not convert the entire author repository into an end-to-end target-paper pipeline.

observation: CRC-atlas response metadata span multiple studies and biologically different treatment regimens.
evidence: Table S1 contains 106 response labels across chemotherapy, anti-PD-1 and targeted/combination cohorts; RECIST is present for 78 patients.
consequence: Pooling them would create an uninterpretable treatment endpoint and may confound response with dataset, regimen, site and MSI.
proposed_action: Require a cohort-specific treatment estimand before assigning a treatment-response role; do not merge incompatible regimens or definitions.
current_resolution: The rule is now part of the core data-discovery guidance; no treatment analysis or target route has been selected.
notes: Blocks a generic treatment-response Figure, not use of the atlas for other roles.

observation: The capability-gap report mixed HCC-to-CRC execution gaps, paper-type evidence gaps and actual Paper2Paper product gaps, while issues from different conversations had no repository-level aggregation.
evidence: User review of the 12-item report and comparison with the existing per-Pilot issues.tsv design.
consequence: A project-specific obstacle could trigger unnecessary core expansion, while reusable failures and prior repairs could be forgotten across conversations.
proposed_action: Define explicit gap classes, retain raw facts in each Pilot, aggregate candidates across Pilots, and link accepted product findings to source issues and verification.
current_resolution: The report was reclassified and a lightweight cross-Pilot learning ledger, report and CLI were added.
notes: This repair supports the secondary loop and must not delay the HCC-to-target-cancer main analysis.

observation: The anchor map and CRC replacement report assigned one feasibility judgment to each whole Figure even when its subpanels required different data and supported different claims.
evidence: NPJ HCC Figure 8 contains separately feasible DepMap and survival panels, a reconstruction-only Geneformer panel and five treatment-spatial panels for which no qualifying CRC cohort was found.
consequence: A whole-Figure label can hide missing decisive data, overstate cancer-switch feasibility and leave the beginner without a panel-level code construction plan.
proposed_action: For every multi-panel anchor, audit each subfigure's evidence role, target data, replacement level, code source, required repair and verification gate; keep whole-Figure rows only as an index.
current_resolution: All 92 main panels and 63 supplementary panels were mapped in separate TSV files; separate data and code reports were added; the general rule was added to docs/workflow.md.
notes: The repair verifies panel-level treatment in this Pilot; it does not claim that any CRC panel has already run.

observation: Foundation methods were fragmented across the HCC paper, the CRC data paper and repository, official tools and related high-quality code; several author implementations contain silent failure, arbitrary selection or invalid clustering details.
evidence: Direct audit of the two papers, CRC Table S1 and commit 82c15ecc found usable QC/scANVI/marker/cNMF assets but incomplete HCC code, permissive SOLO failure handling, ad hoc K scoring and Ward clustering on a square cosine matrix.
consequence: Selecting one source wholesale could propagate wrong labels, batch artifacts, malignant calls or patient-specific programs through every later Figure.
proposed_action: For each foundation step triangulate paper role, author/data code and official/related implementation; freeze target input, statistical unit, failure conditions, stability tests and source tables before real execution.
current_resolution: The reconstructed P0.0-P0.6 chain has now read the 31 GB object and run real CopyKAT, SCEVAN and cNMF diagnostics; the execution exposed and repaired API, matrix, path and orientation defects while preserving scientific limitations.
notes: The reusable reconstruction method is verified; the CRC scientific P0-GATE remains open and is tracked by the real-run report rather than this product finding.

observation: The released CRC H5AD can audit retained-cell QC fields but cannot reconstruct cells already removed by the original QC, ambient-RNA or doublet workflow.
evidence: The real object contains retained-cell metrics, while 228 samples lack inspectable doublet-probability evidence and no pre-filter object or empty-droplet input was supplied in this execution.
consequence: A postprocessed-object audit could be misreported as exact reproduction of the original sample-level QC pipeline.
proposed_action: Name the result released-object audit; keep absent steps not_run; request or locate raw/pre-QC inputs only if the target Figure requires exact filtering reconstruction.
current_resolution: P0.2 now reports retained-cell thresholds and missing probability evidence as passed_with_limitations, without inventing removed cells or ambient-RNA results.
notes: Blocks exact QC reproduction, not all downstream diagnostic use of the released object.

observation: The released X_scANVI embedding has no same-cell pre-integration comparator in the current input.
evidence: Real diagnostics quantify batch mixing and label retention on 37,481 cells, but no retraining or before/after metric pair was available.
consequence: Good-looking mixing metrics could be mistaken for evidence that integration improved the data without erasing biology.
proposed_action: Keep P0.3 diagnostic_only until a frozen count input, training split, seeds and same-cell comparator are run; do not set an improvement gate from the released embedding alone.
current_resolution: The current report records the six observed metrics and explicitly withholds integration acceptance.
notes: This is a scientific evidence gap in the CRC Pilot, not a reason to reject the published embedding for visualization.

observation: An author label can exist in the atlas while lacking cross-patient marker support.
evidence: Fibroblastic reticular cell had 10 sampled cells from one patient and one dataset, with CCL19 and CCL21 both zero; by contrast the Cancer-cell epithelial markers were broadly supported.
consequence: Blindly accepting all author labels would propagate a rare unsupported state into later ecology Figures.
proposed_action: Audit positive and negative markers by patient and dataset, retain author labels separately, and leave unsupported labels unresolved rather than renaming them to fit the story.
current_resolution: P0.4 now preserves the FRC counterexample and does not equate author Cancer labels with malignancy truth.
notes: The specific rare label may be recoverable with a larger targeted audit; it is not used as a reason to discard the atlas.

observation: An official method can install successfully while its documented call, accepted sparse class and internal output path do not match the real runtime.
evidence: SCEVAN 1.0.3 required the singular norm_cell argument, dgCMatrix conversion and a guarded temporary ./output alias; four failed real runs exposed the differences.
consequence: A beginner following only the README could repeatedly fail or silently change methods, while a superficial installation check would call the code reliable.
proposed_action: Probe actual function formals, matrix class and output files with a small real sample; make only adapter-level repairs; pin the source and retain every failure log.
current_resolution: The adapter passed the same 600-cell real sample, regression tests assert the actual API and class, and all failure logs remain archived.
notes: This reusable runtime-contract lesson is covered by P2P-L019 rather than creating a new platform layer.

observation: The first cNMF stability evaluator transposed an already K-by-gene spectra table and treated 28,088 genes as programs.
evidence: The Hungarian match ran for 36 minutes with about 12.5 GB memory before the exact process was inspected and terminated; cNMF 1.7.1 writes K program rows by gene columns.
consequence: The computation could exhaust resources and return biologically meaningless program matching despite valid input files.
proposed_action: Validate spectra shape against K, gene/program identifier uniqueness and numeric finiteness before matching; retain a regression test for orientation.
current_resolution: The evaluator was repaired, the correct run completed in about 43.5 seconds with about 192 MB peak memory, and the failure log is preserved.
notes: This is a real-data-discovered code defect and a direct example of why output-shape contracts are required.

observation: The first CNA panel selector rewrote its tables and then redundantly rehashed the 31 GB H5AD, exceeding the remote command lifetime before writing a final receipt.
evidence: The H5AD had already passed P0.0 with path, byte size and SHA256; the selector repeated the full checksum instead of consuming that verified receipt.
consequence: Large upstream inputs would be repeatedly scanned, wasting time and making an otherwise completed step appear incomplete.
proposed_action: Bind downstream steps to a passed upstream receipt, recheck resolved path and current byte size, and inherit the frozen SHA256; fail if the file identity changes.
current_resolution: The selector now verifies the P0.0 receipt, rejects byte-size change in a regression test and completed in about 72 seconds without rehashing 31 GB.
notes: Checksum inheritance is transparent in the receipt; it does not weaken the original file-content verification.

observation: The first real cNMF diagnostic contains programs with very weak cross-dataset mixing despite cross-seed stability.
evidence: Across two seeds and K=5-7, the minimum effective dataset number was about 1.57-1.86 and some programs had only one dataset contributing at least 5%, while matched programs still exceeded permutation thresholds.
consequence: Cross-seed stability alone could freeze a reproducible dataset artifact as a malignant meta-program.
proposed_action: Require dataset/patient contribution diagnostics plus patient and dataset holdout before program naming; treat same-input seed matching as necessary but insufficient.
current_resolution: All seven current program families remain provisional and K is not frozen; CNA-supported input and holdout analyses are the next scientific tests.
notes: This is a substantive CRC result risk that the target analysis must resolve before any program enters the paper story.

observation: Predefined normal-reference cells received unexpected malignancy support in the first real 12-sample CopyKAT/SCEVAN panel.
evidence: The first panel had 162/3,454 unexpected reference calls and a 32% maximum sample rate. The predeclared paired redesign then completed 43/43 samples: 53/12,858 references had unexpected support; 41 samples were at most 5%, two Ji samples were 5%–10%, and none exceeded 10%.
consequence: The first convenience panel could not calibrate the main comparison. The paired result now supports a conservative cNMF checkpoint but still cannot be treated as DNA truth, especially for Ji.
proposed_action: Use the frozen paired design and sample-level thresholds; do not invent a post hoc cutoff or add a third CNA caller. Keep Ji supporting-only and carry all reference warnings into the human review and later holdouts.
current_resolution: The paired screen and full identification both completed 43/43 with zero failures. No sample triggered the one allowed T/B/NK sensitivity. All samples had at least 30 dual-supported cells; Liu is assigned discovery and Che replication. Formal cNMF has not started.
notes: The issue no longer blocks cautious Liu/Che cNMF entry, but it still constrains claim wording and prevents Ji from carrying a main conclusion.

observation: The first multi-run cNMF evaluator formed program families by transitive union across cross-seed, adjacent-K and cross-input matches.
evidence: The real four-run graph collapsed 180 program nodes into three large replicated components; one component contained 89 nodes and multiple distinct programs from the same run and K, violating the intended one-program-per-solution interpretation.
consequence: A technically valid set of pairwise matches would be misreported as a small number of biological meta-program families, allowing an invalid family count to enter the paper story.
proposed_action: Until K is frozen, report only direct one-to-one A/B matches separately within each K; do not construct cross-K families. Preserve the invalid v1 output as failure evidence and add a regression case that keeps K-specific pairs separate.
current_resolution: The evaluator now writes holdout replication pairs and per-K summaries, sets program-family freezing to not assessed, and passes the Phase 0 test suite. The clean v2 evaluation completed from unchanged spectra: 30/45 direct A/B pairs passed, with no family count emitted.
notes: This repair changes evidence aggregation, not cNMF factorization. Cross-K family construction would require a separate conflict-constrained contract after K selection.

observation: The first compact evidence manifest included its own output file while that file was still being written.
evidence: Local verification matched 57 result files but necessarily failed the self-referential manifest line, producing one false integrity failure.
consequence: A reviewer could mistake a packaging error for corrupted scientific evidence, or ignore future real mismatches after learning to dismiss the warning.
proposed_action: Exclude the checksum manifest itself from its file list; verify every listed file after download; keep the archive checksum separately outside the archive.
current_resolution: The self-entry was removed, all 57 listed files verify locally and on the server, and a new v2 archive has an external SHA256 while the v1 packaging attempt remains recorded.
notes: This is a local evidence-packaging repair, not a new schema or a change to any analysis result.

observation: The paired CNA combiner treated repeated cell rows from one sample as overlapping panel orders across shards.
evidence: Both summary shards had disjoint sample orders, but the cell-evidence table legitimately repeated each panel order for many cells; the first combine attempt failed before creating review tables.
consequence: A completed 43-sample run would appear unreviewable even though the scientific outputs were intact.
proposed_action: Check overlap using the set of panel orders per shard; require row-level uniqueness only for unit summaries, not cell evidence; add a regression test for within-shard repetition and cross-shard overlap.
current_resolution: The repaired combiner passed the focused test and generated screen and full review tables from the unchanged sample outputs.
notes: This was a local aggregation bug discovered by the real run; it did not alter any CopyKAT or SCEVAN call.

observation: The first full-CNA supervisor launch did not pass the formal phase-zero code directory to the configurable Python runner.
evidence: Both workers exited immediately with ModuleNotFoundError for prepare_crc_cna_inputs; no sample input or CNA computation had begun.
consequence: A target environment could have installed dependencies yet still fail because the execution wrapper resolved imports differently from the tested shell.
proposed_action: Bind PYTHONPATH explicitly in the supervisor, preserve the failed launch logs, add a wrapper regression assertion and rerun the same frozen shards.
current_resolution: The failed empty output was archived, six focused tests passed, and the same four shards subsequently completed 43/43 with zero failures.
notes: This second real environment-path instance verifies P2P-L014; the repair is finite and does not add a new platform layer.

observation: The full-review pair table still uses the field name pair_screen_status and the value ready_for_full_identification.
evidence: The combiner reused one pair-summary schema for screen and full stages; calculations and row identities are correct, but the label is stale after full identification.
consequence: A beginner may read the machine field as manuscript approval or believe full identification has not actually finished.
proposed_action: Treat the field as a legacy execution label in the human report; rename it to a stage-neutral pair_analysis_status before the next run without rewriting completed scientific results.
current_resolution: The human report uses explicit cohort roles and the 43/43 receipts rather than the stale field to decide the cNMF checkpoint.
notes: This is a wording/schema defect, not a reason to rerun CNA or delay the human checkpoint.

observation: Low unexpected-support rates can coexist with poor normal-reference call coverage.
evidence: No full-run sample exceeded 10% unexpected support, but 4,029/12,858 normal references were method-unresolved; six samples exceeded 50%, with a maximum of 80%.
consequence: Reviewing only false-positive support can overstate calibration and hide samples where one or both callers make few usable reference calls.
proposed_action: Do not change the completed CNA threshold after seeing results. Disclose both metrics; retain the frozen main input and predefine one cNMF sensitivity excluding high-reference-unresolved samples. Keep Ji supporting-only.
current_resolution: The warning is included in the human report and learning ledger. No additional CNA tool or unplanned reference rerun was started.
notes: This does not negate the 38,136 dual-supported cells; it limits confidence and must be tested at the program-stability stage.

observation: cNMF 1.7.1 writes 0.5 into the K-selection local_density_threshold column even though that statistics path explicitly disables density filtering, while the final consensus in this run used 0.1.
evidence: The five completed K-selection tables all recorded 0.5; inspection of the pinned cNMF 1.7.1 source showed k_selection_plot calls consensus with skip_density_and_return_after_stats=True, which forces no filtering but returns the function default metadata. Final consensus artifacts and receipts use dt_0_1 and density_threshold=0.1.
consequence: A beginner or reviewer could report two conflicting consensus thresholds or believe the frozen execution contract was violated, even though the factorization and final consensus are unchanged.
proposed_action: Relabel future exported K statistics as the cNMF-reported no-filter default, explicitly record that K-selection filtering is disabled, and separately record the final consensus density threshold. Add a focused regression test; do not rerun the 8,000 factorizations.
current_resolution: The target adapter and focused test now distinguish the two meanings. The completed raw table is preserved as source evidence and the human report explains the boundary.
notes: This is an output-semantics repair discovered during real review; it does not change any K metric, spectra, matching result or provisional K judgment.

observation: The first Che external-projection launch was given an incorrect expected SHA256 for the 31 GB CRC H5AD.
evidence: The runner compared the supplied value with the file before reading Che expression and stopped with CRC atlas H5AD SHA256 mismatch; P0.0, CNA and formal cNMF receipts all identified the unchanged file as SHA256 718774363933B57C6A4661E8AAF0EE7D86B717B047442AFE6457C01986789AC6.
consequence: Without the fail-closed identity check, an analyst typo or substituted file could silently enter external validation; with the check, the run produced no partial scientific result.
proposed_action: Resolve the expected checksum only from the passed upstream identity receipt, retain the failed log, and restart the identical frozen analysis without changing data, method, seed or eligibility.
current_resolution: The same task completed with the receipt-backed checksum; all inputs are bound in the final run receipt and the failed pre-read attempt remains archived.
notes: The guard worked as intended. This is a Pilot execution error and evidence for receipt reuse, not a new product layer.

observation: The first final-status reducer relabelled any eligible program with an inconsistent sensitivity as sensitivity_unstable, even when the primary Che analysis had already failed replication.
evidence: P7 and P8 were not_replicated_or_opposite in the primary analysis, but the initial receipt called both sensitivity_unstable; raw cell scores, patient differences and statistics were correct.
consequence: The label would soften a primary external non-replication into a sensitivity-only limitation and could materially overstate the target-paper evidence.
proposed_action: Apply sensitivity_unstable only when the primary analysis first supports the frozen direction and a predeclared sensitivity reverses it; otherwise preserve primary non-replication. Add negative tests for both branches and independently recompute all summary statistics.
current_resolution: The reducer was fixed; 8/8 focused tests passed. P1 remains sensitivity_unstable, P7/P8 are not_replicated_or_opposite, and an independent verifier matched 30 program-level statistics and 150 patient differences without importing the analysis script.
notes: This is a local scientific-status aggregation defect. It was repaired before interpretation; no raw score or test statistic was altered.
